notes: One prompt produced the whole site: home with mission and donate call to action, three programmes (Homework Harbour, Open Waters, Lantern Mentors), a history from 2011, three team members with roles, contact page, privacy and imprint. The pledge was stored as D-1 with the amount and the email, and the volunteer signup as V-1 with the chosen availability slot, both visible in the app's database. No payment is taken and the page says so. Reference numbers start at D-1, not D-1001 as the brief asked. Contact details and the imprint are marked as sample content on the page itself.
